sourceHashFormat: SHA-256 of source text normalized to LF

method.bootstrapUniverse: All completed-game opening groups, including groups without eligible sampled positions.
method.wholePieceIntervals: Add ordinary family and upgrade bonus within each same normalized bootstrap refit, then take percentiles.
method.featureSelection: Omit only structurally unobserved bonus columns; keep all ordinary and observed bonus columns.

method.ridgeScale: mean game-weighted loss; penalty on standardized slopes
method.weighting: each sampled game has unit total weight
method.normalizationThreshold: Conservative reporting policy, not a confidence guarantee or a reason to generate more games automatically.
method.regularizationCaveat: Ridge produces finite exploratory slopes even for some separated outcomes; absence of a perfect-classification flag does not exclude quasi-separation.
method.interpretation: Exploratory outcome-predictive coefficients conditional on this selected dataset and playing policy; not intrinsic or causal piece values.
method.anchorConstraint: beta_queen = 9 * beta_pawn with positive fitted score conversion
method.anchorPenalty: Both original pawn and queen standardized slopes retain their ridge penalties.

bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional opening-block percentile ranges; failed fits are counted, and all games in each selected opening share one multiplicity.

normalized.interpretation: Conditional fitted ratios under assumed pawn=1 and queen=9. Fixed anchors are assumptions, not measured values or uncertainty bounds.

warnings: Recorded settings and replayed legal moves do not attest the executable or process identity; missing execution provenance remains unknown.

Samples from the same game and related openings are dependent; use game-balanced weights and grouped validation/resampling.

Each sampled game has total weight one; games with no accepted positions are retained in coverage but contribute no fitting weight.
